statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail). For an integer d, define B(d) to be the maximum number of pairwise disjoint intervals [s, s+k-1] of indices with 0 <= s and s+k-1 < n such that bloomDay[i] <= d for every i with s <= i <= s+k-1. Equivalently, B(d) is the sum, over all maximal contiguous runs of indices i for which bloomDay[i] <= d, of floor(run_length / k). If there exists a nonnegative integer d with B(d) >= m, then r is the least such d; otherwise r = -1.
preconditions: Let n = len(bloomDay). 1 <= n <= 100000; for every integer i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= bloomDay[i] <= 1000000000; 1 <= m <= 1000000; 1 <= k <= n.
